purpose: Screen same-host throughput before another long baseline run; exclude all diagnostic weights from gait selection and reward comparisons.
configuration_policy: Each fresh process restores the same parent checkpoint, Adam state and adaptive rate, then resets at common_step_counter 120000. Only scene/terrain environment count, output name and diagnostic update count may differ. Retain rewards, physics, observations, precision, four minibatches and locked dependencies. A larger batch changes optimization; no gait claim is allowed.
timing_policy: Use all 20 prespecified complete updates after warmup. Report transitions per second, per-update p50/p95 and separate collection/learning time. Keep spikes and failures; record whole-process time separately. Initial recording lies in warmup, so this screen does not measure periodic recording overhead.

selection_rule.pairing: Compare each size to the 1024 run in the same ordered pass.
selection_rule.tie_break: Choose the eligible size with the largest geometric mean throughput; retain 1024 if none qualifies.
selection_rule.origin: Project decision rule fixed before this screen; not an official threshold or proof of population-level improvement. Review clock, power and run-order confounding.
